current_operating_snapshot.warning: Naive multiples are diagnostic only. Mercado Pago customer funds, loan originations/funding, required financial capital and credit losses make software-style FCF multiples economically incomplete.

cash_and_financial_capital_rule.rule: Restricted cash and customer funds are not surplus cash. Financial liabilities and credit assets must be treated symmetrically. The owner-cash model is after credit losses and required financial-capital reinvestment; it does not mechanically add customer/restricted cash to equity value.

model_continuity.change_from_previous_model: Price reference updated from $1,978.36 to $1,876.33; existing component economics and 9% hurdle retained to isolate expectation-gap change. New Q2 evidence is used to re-underwrite quality and veto status rather than silently rewriting the frozen prior model assumptions.

reverse_expectations.method: Hold the existing base year-1 revenue, owner-margin paths, rights treatment and terminal assumptions; solve common growth required for years 2-10 to match the updated reference price.
reverse_expectations.interpretation: The lower reference price reduces the market-implied growth burden. Required growth is below the current reported revenue-growth rate, but this does not remove credit-loss and reinvestment risk because the model assumes future owner margins after required capital.

bear.interpretation: Commerce growth slows, fintech owner margin remains low after credit losses/required capital, and current reinvestment fails to earn the hurdle.

base.interpretation: Commerce/logistics and fintech reinforce engagement while credit and shipping investments mature into positive owner cash returns.

bull.interpretation: Strong multi-product network effects, advertising, payments and credit scale with high mature owner margins and long growth duration.

scenario_warning: The Bear-to-Bull spread is intentionally very wide. It reflects uncertainty around financial-capital intensity, credit-card vintage economics, free-shipping reinvestment, FX and country/regulatory risk. It must not be interpreted as a precise probability distribution.
valuation_conclusion: The updated price does not require an unrealistic bull case under the retained owner-cash model, so that veto remains PASS. However, the apparent Base upside is conditional on unproven reinvestment economics; valuation cannot override the open low-quality-growth, incremental-ROIC and permanent-loss veto investigations.
